name: Thirty-One
source:
There are only thirty students in this classroom. But I know one more person among us.

The unknown "thirty-one". Nobody notices him, nobody can see him. But I know he is there, blending in the background, observing from close proximity; and I know he pretends to be one of us. When our eyes keep catch each other, I don't know what's the meaning behind his faint smile. Nor I know what his dark eyes can see.

[From [url=https://eikitaraaaa.itch.io/thirty-one]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
這間教室裡只有三十名學生。可我知道，我們中間還有一個人。

那個來歷不明的「第三十一人」。沒人留意他，沒人看得見他。可我知道他就在那裡，不動聲色地混入背景，在近處觀察著我們。我也知道，他在假裝自己是我們中的一員。我們的目光一次次相遇，我讀不懂他嘴角那一絲笑意，也不知道那雙幽暗的眼睛究竟能看見什麼。

［摘自[url=https://eikitaraaaa.itch.io/thirty-one]itch.io[/url]］
